changelog: Themed partner application page: the legal footer uses the theme's own text colour (whose contrast on the page background is checked when the theme is saved) instead of a fixed grey nobody checked against it. Tests: the `stats`-only audit detail (`changedLandingFields`) and the themed footer's legal/contract links on `/partner` and `/partner/apply` (#3730).

en: Partner application page: with a custom theme, the footer links are now readable on the theme's background.
tr: Partner başvuru sayfası: özel temada alt bilgi bağlantıları artık temanın arka planında okunaklı.
de: Partnerbewerbung: Mit eigenem Design sind die Links in der Fußzeile auf dem Hintergrund des Designs jetzt gut lesbar.
